items.title: AtomicRL: Atomic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
items.title_zh: AtomicRL：用于长时程机器人操作的原子强化学习
items.summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中显示出前景，但仅靠模仿学习（IL）往往难以掌握复杂的长时程技能。强化学习（RL）为进一步改进VLA策略提供了有效途径。然而，现有VLA-RL方法通常因轨迹级稀疏奖励而遭受延迟和有偏的信用分配，同时子任务掌握不均衡造成瓶颈，限制整体性能。为应对这些挑战，我们提出AtomicRL，一个利用原子任务结构实现可靠信用分配和自适应探索的RL后训练框架。AtomicRL引入语义感知策略优化（SAPO），使用语义感知门控约束失败原子子任务的TD残差跨任务边界传播，减轻信用污染，同时保留子任务内信用分配和价值引导。此外，瓶颈自适应目标探索（BATE）根据各原子子任务的掌握程度动态协调任务采样和局部探索激励，将学习导向剩余瓶颈。最后，我们开发了Real2Sim2Real流程，将仿真中的在线RL与真实世界部署衔接，促进向物理机器人的实际迁移。在LIBERO-LONG

extra.description: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise in robotic manipulation, but imitation learning (IL) alone often struggles to master complex long-horizon skills. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers an effective avenue for further improving VLA policies. However, existing VLA-RL methods typically suffer from delayed and biased credit assignment due to trajectory-level sparse rewards, while imbalanced subtask mastery creates bottlenecks that limit overall performance. To address these challenges, we propose AtomicRL, an RL post-training framework that leverages atomic task structures for reliable credit assignment and adaptive exploration. AtomicRL introduces Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO), which uses semantic-aware gating to constrain TD residuals from failed atomic subtasks from propagating across task boundaries, mitigating credit contamination while preserving intra-subtask credit assignment and value bootstrapping. In addition, Bottleneck-Adaptive Target Exploration (BATE) dynamically coordinates task sampling and local exploration incentives based on the mastery of individual atomic subtasks, directing learning toward the remaining bottlenecks. Finally, we develop a Real2Sim2Real pipeline that bridges online RL in simulation with real-world deployment, facilitating practical transfer to physical robots. On LIBERO-LONG, AtomicRL achieves absolute performance gains of 3.6% and 4.0% over PPO across two VLA architectures. On CALVIN ABC-D, it improves full-task performance by up to 9.5% over PPO. Combined with the Real2Sim2Real pipeline, AtomicRL further improves real-world task performance by an average of 21.3%. These results demonstrate that AtomicRL effectively improves the learning efficiency and manipulation performance of VLA policies on long-horizon tasks.

items.title: BatchBench: Benchmarking AI Robustness to Batch Effects and Domain Shift in Biomedical Images - A JUMP Cell Painting Leaderboard
items.title_zh: BatchBench：基准测试AI对生物医学图像中批次效应和域偏移的鲁棒性——JUMP Cell Painting排行榜
items.summary_zh: 尽管近期取得进展，当前AI系统仍极易受域偏移影响，尤其在生物医学成像中，图像通常在显著不同的实验条件下采集。尽管近期域适应方法已取得实质进展，域偏移下的显著性能差距仍然存在。为衡量这方面的进展，我们推出BatchBench，一个评估和比较AI系统在来自未见实验批次和数据源的生物医学图像上鲁棒性的排行榜。BatchBench基于JUMP-CP构建，这是最大的公开生物医学成像数据集之一。JUMP-CP使用Cell Painting assay生成，表现出明显的批次效应和域偏移，使其成为评估对分布变化鲁棒性的挑战性测试平台。

extra.description: Despite recent advances, current AI systems remain highly susceptible to domain shifts, particularly in biomedical imaging, where images are usually acquired under substantially different experimental conditions. Although recent domain adaptation methods have made substantial progress, significant performance gaps under domain shift persist. To measure progress in this regard, we introduce BatchBench, a leaderboard that evaluates and compares the robustness of AI systems on biomedical images from unseen experimental batches and data sources. BatchBench is built on JUMP-CP, one of the largest publicly available biomedical imaging datasets. Generated using the Cell Painting assay, JUMP-CP exhibits pronounced batch effects and domain shifts, making it a challenging testbed for evaluating robustness to distributional changes.

items.title: An autoencoder outperforms two transformers on prediction of gene expression from chromatin accessibility
items.title_zh: 自编码器在从染色质可及性预测基因表达上优于两个 transformer
items.summary_zh: 从染色质可及性预测 RNA 丰度的模型很少在相同特征、目标和指标下比较。我们在来自 19 项人类研究的 126,604 个配对单核图谱上构建了一个基准，共享 50,000 个峰和 3,185 个基因的词表、十个 5x2 交叉验证折和一个评分目标，并在 70 次训练运行中比较了七个已实现流程和两个参考预测器；每个流程保留自己的输入归一化和原生训练目标。基于双变分自编码器的 scButterfly-B 流程在所有六十个配对折比较中，在每基因和细胞内 Spearman 相关上优于所有 transformer 流程，包括自回归 Perceiver 模型（Omic Translator）和无支持重构的 Cisformer，训练时间短 3.8 倍。Transformer 流程在细胞内轮廓形状上差距为 0.02-0.04，但在每基因相关上落后 0.10-0.24。在两个留出细胞类型上每基因相关较低；对照

extra.description: Models that predict RNA abundance from chromatin accessibility are rarely compared under the same features, targets and metrics. We built one benchmark on 126,604 paired single-nucleus profiles from 19 human studies with a shared vocabulary of 50,000 peaks and 3,185 genes, ten 5x2 cross-validation folds and one scoring target, and compared seven implemented pipelines and two reference predictors across 70 trained runs; each pipeline keeps its own input normalisation and native training target. The scButterfly-B pipeline, built on dual variational autoencoders, outperformed every transformer pipeline, including an autoregressive Perceiver model (Omic Translator) and a support-free reformulation of Cisformer, on per-gene and within-cell Spearman correlation in all sixty paired fold comparisons, with 3.8 times shorter training. Transformer pipelines come within 0.02-0.04 on within-cell profile shape but lag by 0.10-0.24 on per-gene correlation. On two withheld cell types per-gene correlation is low; controls show the podocyte values are typical of within-type correlation for seen cell types of the same size, whereas Paneth values match a cell-agnostic shuffle for every Omic Translator arm. Within the transformer family, prespecified ablations show the Perceiver encoder was worth +0.0439 in within-donor per-gene correlation over full self-attention, a chromosome-aware genomic attention prior reduced it by 0.0096 (exact donor-level sign-flip test, Holm-adjusted p = 1.2e-4), and decoder output order had no detectable effect. A training-mean profile reaches 0.314 within-cell correlation with no input and a constant at the true expressed-gene positions reaches 0.996 per-gene correlation, so oracle-support protocols are reported only as diagnostics. Code, results and an audited release are provided.

items.title: Spatially Informed and Direction Sensitive Representation Learning for Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: 面向空间转录组学的空间信息感知和方向敏感表示学习
items.summary_zh: 细胞状态由内在基因表达程序和细胞所在的空间微环境共同塑造。空间转录组学使这一背景变得可测量，但有效的表示学习需要同时捕获空间信息分子信号和细胞间组织。现有方法只能部分解决这些挑战：传统基因选择可能忽略空间结构化信号，而编码细胞-细胞关系的方法通常要么将细胞的微环境简化为仅邻近性，丢弃方向，要么依赖与任意组织框架绑定的绝对坐标。因此，具有相似邻居距离但不同空间组织的细胞可能获得过于相似的表示，尽管它们经历着塑造其细胞状态的不同生物背景。我们介绍Tessera，一个空间表示学习框架，同时解决分子选择和细胞背景问题。Tessera将空间信息基因选择与几何归纳偏置相结合，将每个细胞置于其局部组织环境中。通过建模相对细胞-细胞关系，Tessera具有平移不变性同时保留方向，允许邻近细胞根据其空间背景和细胞状态做出不同贡献。在留出组织和技术上，Tessera在表示质量上优于现有空间基础模型，并零样本泛

extra.description: Cellular states are shaped by both intrinsic gene expression programs and the spatial microenvironment in which cells reside. Spatial transcriptomics makes this context measurable, but effective representation learning requires capturing both spatially informative molecular signals and intercellular organization. Existing approaches address these challenges only partially: conventional gene selection can overlook spatially structured signals, while methods for encoding cell-cell relationships often either reduce a cell's microenvironment to proximity alone, discarding direction, or rely on absolute coordinates tied to an arbitrary tissue frame. Consequently, cells with similar neighbor distances but distinct spatial organization may receive overly similar representations, despite experiencing different biological contexts that shape their cellular states. We introduce Tessera, a spatial representation learning framework that addresses both molecular selection and cellular context. Tessera combines spatially informed gene selection with a geometric inductive bias that contextualizes each cell within its local tissue environment. By modeling relative cell-cell relationships, Tessera is translation-invariant while preserving direction, allowing neighboring cells to contribute differently according to their spatial context and cellular state. Across held-out tissues and technologies, Tessera outperforms existing spatial foundation models in representation quality and generalizes zero-shot to contexts up to $16\times$ larger than those seen during training.

items.title: gpuGEM: GPU-based linear optimisation of genome-scale metabolic models
items.title_zh: gpuGEM：基于GPU的基因组尺度代谢模型线性优化
items.summary_zh: 摘要：基因组尺度代谢模型在重复优化工作流中日益挑战CPU线性规划求解器。我们提出gpuGEM，一个使用NVIDIA cuOpt进行基于GPU的GEM优化的开源Python库，具有针对HiGHS和Gurobi验证的尺寸自适应设置。在涵盖四个数量级问题规模的十个模型基准套件中，gpuGEM相对于每个模型更快的HiGHS对偶单纯形和内点法实现了1.1倍至94倍的加速。gpuGEM在十个模型中的三个上也优于Gurobi，加速为1.6倍至2.5倍。在候选基因优先级工作流中，gpuGEM将端到端查询时间从41秒减少到21秒。可用性与实现：gpuGEM在MIT许可证下发布于https://github.com/Digital-Metabolic-Twin-Centre/gpuGEM和PyPI（pip install gpugem）。存档版本（v0.1.2）可在https://zenodo.org/rec

extra.description: Summary: Genome-scale metabolic models increasingly challenge CPU linear-programming solvers in repeated-optimisation workflows. We present gpuGEM, an open-source Python library for GPU-based GEM optimisation using NVIDIA cuOpt, with size-adaptive settings validated against HiGHS and Gurobi. Across a ten-model benchmark suite spanning four orders of magnitude in problem size, gpuGEM achieved speed-ups of 1.1x to 94x relative to the faster of the HiGHS dual-simplex and interior-point methods for each model. gpuGEM also outperformed Gurobi on three of ten models, with speed-ups of 1.6x to 2.5x. In a candidate-gene prioritisation workflow, gpuGEM reduced end-to-end query time from 41 s to 21 s. Availability and Implementation: gpuGEM is released under the MIT licence at https://github.com/Digital-Metabolic-Twin-Centre/gpuGEM and on PyPI (pip install gpugem). An archived release(v0.1.2) is available at https://zenodo.org/records/23422813. gpuGEM requires an NVIDIA GPU, Python 3.11 or later, CUDA 12 and cuOpt 26.6 or later. cuOpt requires a GPU with Volta architecture or newer (compute capability 7.0 or newer). Contact: ronan.mt.fleming@gmail.com Supplementary information: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
items.title_zh: OmicsBench：AI智能体在研究级生物信息学上的长时程多轮基准
items.summary_zh: 计算生物学家越来越多地将大量分析委托给AI智能体进行长时程、多轮会话，但大多数智能体生物信息学能力基准只提出单一短任务和单次提示。我们提出OmicsBench，一个面向AI智能体的长时程、多轮生物信息学基准。其97个任务各自将依赖子任务连接成有向无环图，总共662个底层子任务。每个子任务作为一个用户轮次提出，并针对答案键进行确定性评分，对错误答案提供可选的上下文反馈。在三种框架上的12个模型中，最慢的智能体平均每任务耗时3.6小时，没有任何组合接近饱和该基准，无上下文反馈时平均得分为0.43至0.57（满分1），有反馈时为0.54至0.67。多轮评估还揭示了单次提示无法发现的行为，因为智能体在依赖早期子任务的子任务上得分较低，而上下文反馈帮助智能体挽回部分损失。由于确定性评分无法定性说明智能体如何失败，我们还引入了一个无监督失败模式发现流程，用于描述、嵌入和聚类智能体的失败尝试，以揭示涌现

extra.description: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.

items.title: Truecell reproduces R Seurat's single-cell analysis outputs natively in the Python ecosystem
items.title_zh: Truecell 在 Python 生态中原生复现 R Seurat 的单细胞分析输出
items.summary_zh: 单细胞 RNA 测序分析主要使用 Seurat（R）或 Scanpy（Python），选择通常由编程语言偏好驱动。然而，默认情况下，这些工具产生不同的可变特征、邻居图、聚类和标记基因。需要 Python（支持大多数深度学习、基础模型和代理工具）的实验室必须在无法复现 Seurat 结果的框架中重新实现 Seurat 分析。Truecell 被开发为 Seurat 接口的 Python 实现，保留函数名称、参数、默认设置和对象模型，以促进分析的无缝转移。在十八个与 R Seurat 的配对端到端评估中，确定性输出匹配到浮点精度，并且折叠变化顺序在所有九个差异表达测试中相同。在三个数据集上的三臂基准测试中，固定用户参数和每个工具 20 个种子，Truecell 在所有 12 个数据集和分辨率设置组合中比配置 Seurat 的 Scanpy 更接近地复现 Seurat 的聚类。Truecell

extra.description: Single-cell RNA-sequencing analyses predominantly use either Seurat (R) or Scanpy (Python), with the choice often driven by programming language preference. However, by default, these tools produce divergent variable features, neighbour graphs, clusters, and marker genes. Laboratories requiring Python, which supports most deep-learning, foundation-model, and agent tools, must re-implement Seurat analyses in a framework that does not replicate Seurat's results. Truecell was developed as a Python implementation of the Seurat interface, preserving function names, arguments, default settings, and the object model to facilitate seamless transfer of analyses. In eighteen paired end-to-end evaluations against R Seurat, deterministic outputs matched to floating-point precision, and fold-change order was identical across all nine differential expression tests. In a three-arm benchmark on three datasets, with fixed user parameters and 20 seeds per tool, Truecell more closely reproduced Seurat's clustering than a Seurat-configured Scanpy in all 12 combinations of dataset and resolution settings. Truecell's marker genes and enriched pathways were also closer to Seurat's than Scanpy's were, and pseudobulk DESeq2 reproduced Seurat's gene lists with a Jaccard index ranging from 0.95 to 1.00. This agreement reflects fidelity to Seurat rather than biological correctness.

items.title: Schrödinger-Bass Bridge Barycenter Models for Measure-Valued Data
items.title_zh: 面向测度值数据的 Schrödinger-Bass 桥重心模型
items.summary_zh: 基于概率测度间随机和确定性最优传输桥的重心模型已被证明对（概率）测度值数据的监督和无监督学习有用。本文利用最近提出的两测度间 Schrödinger-Bass 桥（SBB）中出现的方向不对称和对偶漂移扩散控制，提出 \textit{SBB-encoder}、\textit{SBB-decoder}、\textit{SBB-symmetric} 和 \textit{SBB-Markovian} 重心模型。对每个新模型，我们的第一个理论结果在温和假设下建立 SBB 重心的存在性。第二个理论结果刻画高斯的解码器 SBB 重心，我们证明对高斯输入测度，解码器形式允许高斯极小化子，将重心计算简化为有限维优化并产生紧凑算法。对一般输入测度，我们使用 SBB 对偶表示为所有四种形式推导混合 Wasserstein 梯度粒子下降方案。最后，我们利用这些算法求解空间图像和单细胞 RNA 测序数据中出现的分布

extra.description: Barycenter models, based on stochastic and deterministic optimal transport bridges between probability measures, have proven to be useful for supervised and unsupervised learning for (probability) measure-valued data. In this paper, we utilize the directional asymmetry and dual drift-diffusion control arising in the recently proposed Schrödinger-Bass Bridge (SBB) between two measures, and propose \textit{SBB-encoder}, \textit{SBB-decoder}, \textit{SBB-symmetric}, and \textit{SBB-Markovian} barycenter models. For each of these novel models, our first theoretical result establishes the existence of the SBB-barycenter under mild assumptions. Our second theoretical result characterizes the decoder SBB-barycenter of Gaussians where we show that for Gaussian input measures, the decoder formulation admits a Gaussian minimizer, reducing barycenter computation to a finite-dimensional optimization and yielding a compact algorithm. For general input measures, we derive a hybrid Wasserstein gradient particle descent scheme for all four formulations using the SBB dual representation. Finally, we utilize these algorithms for solving distributional-inverse/interpolation problems arising in the context of spatial images and single-cell RNA sequencing data, where we show that the SBB-decoder and Markovian barycenter allow us to interpolate between successive time points. Results show that our method outperforms existing barycenter models for measure interpolation and inference.

items.title: VGL-stGen: Learning a shared multimodal model for lung histology and spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: VGL-stGen：学习肺组织学和空间转录组学的共享多模态模型
items.summary_zh: VGL-stGen是一个多模态大语言模型，从预训练医学视觉-语言模型改编而来，使用配对的肺H&E和空间转录组学及单细胞参考。训练整合了图像-表达和表达-细胞类型配对，基因条件伪标签将转录组细胞类型监督转移到组织学图像。一个部署的检查点支持十三项评估任务，涵盖组织和细胞类型分类、基因预测以及从组织学、细胞身份和观察到的基因表达组合进行条件表达完成。任务特定解码产生分类标签、基因列表和结构化表达水平。对于条件完成，固定查询基因身份并自回归预测其水平可改善结构化预测。受控适应表明，将监督限制在请求的表达水平标记上可以进一步改善图像条件完成。图像置换实验表明，正确配对的组织学增加了超出观察表达的信息。外部分类部分依赖具有共享注释谱系的计算参考，一些H&E来源在癌症训练或模型开发期间被暴露。在这些条件下，VGL-stGen展示了医学视觉-语言骨干如何从空间转录组学和组织学中学习，通过共享生成建模连接

extra.description: VGL-stGen is a multimodal large language model adapted from a pretrained medical vision-language model using paired lung H&E and spatial transcriptomics with single-cell references. Training integrates image-expression and expression-cell-type pairs, and gene-conditioned pseudo-labels transfer transcriptomic cell-type supervision to histology images. One deployed checkpoint supports thirteen evaluated tasks spanning tissue and cell-type classification, gene prediction and conditional expression completion from combinations of histology, cell identity and observed gene expression. Task-specific decoding produces categorical labels, gene lists and structured expression levels. For conditional completion, fixing queried gene identities and predicting their levels autoregressively improves structured prediction. Controlled adaptation shows that restricting supervision to requested expression-level tokens can further improve image-conditioned completion. Image-permutation experiments indicate that correctly paired histology adds information beyond observed expression. External classification relies partly on computational references with shared annotation lineage, and some H&E sources were exposed during cancer training or model development. Within these conditions, VGL-stGen demonstrates how a medical vision-language backbone can learn from spatial transcriptomics and histology to connect tissue morphology and molecular states through shared generative modeling.

items.title: BARRR: Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression for Multi-View Multi-Cohort Data
items.title_zh: BARRR：用于多视图多队列数据的双向增强降秩回归
items.summary_zh: 跨多个队列（即样本组）和视图（即来源或模态）的双向数据整合在生物医学研究中至关重要，以从异质数据集中获得整体见解。然而，大多数现有整合方法侧重于单一维度，如跨不同来源的多视图整合或跨不同样本组的多队列整合。现有的双向整合方法稀缺且主要无监督，忽视了协变量提供的宝贵见解。为解决这一空白，我们引入双向增强降秩回归（baRRR）方法。我们的方法同时建模协变量相关和不相关效应，同时在两个维度上分解效应水平（全局、部分共享和个体）。大量模拟证明了我们的方法在信号恢复、结果预测和缺失数据插补方面的优势。我们将方法应用于癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）数据，使用体细胞突变作为协变量来告知不同组学平台和癌症类型间的变异模式。这些研究突出了其作为生物医学研究中稳健且适应性强的整合分析工具的潜力。

extra.description: Bidimensional data integration across multiple cohorts (i.e., sample groups) and views (i.e., sources or modalities) is crucial in biomedical research to derive holistic insights from heterogeneous datasets. However, most existing integrative methods focus on a single dimension, such as multi-view integration across distinct sources or multi-cohort integration across distinct sample groups. Existing approaches for bidimensional integration are scarce and predominantly unsupervised, overlooking the valuable insights offered by covariates. To address this gap, we introduce the Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression (baRRR) method. Our approach models covariate-related and unrelated effects concurrently, while also decomposing effect levels (global, partially shared, and individual) across both dimensions. Extensive simulations demonstrate the advantages of our method with respect to signal recovery, outcome prediction, and missing data imputation. We apply our approach to data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), using somatic mutations as covariates to inform patterns of variability across different omics platforms and cancer types. These studies highlight its potential as a robust and adaptable tool for integrative analysis in biomedical research.

items.title: Reducing double-dipping in single-cell topic models with three-way count splitting
items.title_zh: 用三向计数拆分减少单细胞主题模型中的双重 dipping
items.summary_zh: 主题模型从单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中学习基因程序，然后相同的计数被用于测试哪些基因和供体与这些程序相关。计数拆分是这种复用的标准补救措施，但当编码器读取每个细胞的计数时尚未被测试。在一个104,400细胞的狼疮队列中，每次运行300个置换零基因，朴素检验在名义5%水平下拒绝了36%的零基因-主题对，而通常的两向拆分拒绝了38%，因为编码器看到了被检验基因自身的留出计数。在单独的第三个计数上编码主题使用，使用beta-二项稀疏化，将此降低到7.7%（模型外基因为6.7%）；对于另外两个模型LDVAE和scETM，该率为7.0-7.3%（朴素为51-59%）。一个无标签干扰素程序在狼疮队列和预先指定的COVID-19队列的留出计数中发生偏移，供体水平主题使用预测疾病（AUROC 0.96），超越细胞类型比例（两个队列中分别为0.86和0.58）。校准和预测不依赖于模型。我们不

extra.description: Topic models learn gene programs from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, and the same counts are then used to test which genes and donors are associated with those programs. Count splitting is the standard remedy for this reuse, but it has not been tested when an encoder reads each cell's counts. On a 104,400-cell lupus cohort with 300 permuted null genes per run, naive tests rejected 36% of null gene-topic pairs at a nominal 5% level, and the usual two-way split rejected 38%, because the encoder sees the tested gene's own held-out count. Encoding topic usage on a separate third of the counts, with beta-binomial thinning, lowered this to 7.7% (6.7% for genes outside the model); for two other models, LDVAE and scETM, the rate was 7.0-7.3% (naive 51-59%). A label-free interferon program shifts in held-out counts in the lupus cohort and in a pre-specified COVID-19 cohort, and donor-level topic usage predicts disease (AUROC 0.96) beyond cell-type proportions (0.86 and 0.58 in the two cohorts). Calibration and prediction did not depend on the model. We do not claim better clustering, prediction or topic stability. Code, figures and result tables are public (MIT license; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23307193).

items.title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
items.title_zh: 理解基因表达到图像学习：空间结构与信息保真度
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）使生物异质性的细胞水平分析成为可能，但从高维、无序基因表达谱学习有效表示仍具挑战性。基因表达到图像（GE2I）通过将基因值排列在像素网格上供卷积神经网络使用，提供了一种有效学习策略，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们在全转录组数据上研究GE2I，同时保持网络和训练过程固定。我们的结果揭示了空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的权衡。结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，支持更快的早期优化，而将多个基因分配到同一像素会模糊表达差异并可能降低预测性能。这种权衡解释了为什么当表示许多基因时，随机映射可以与结构化布局竞争。即使图像平滑性降低，一对一基因到像素分配在测试的视觉骨干网络中也能改善预测。我们进一步发现预训练和增强的益处取决于骨干网络和映射。这些发现为像素分配和将视觉先验迁移到基因表达数据提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

items.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
items.title_zh: 细胞命运分配中的预测多重性：无标签 Rashomon 集和逐细胞认证的局限
items.summary_zh: 单细胞轨迹推断将转录组测量映射到发育连续体上，但同样拟合数据的配置可能分配冲突的细胞命运。FateMultiplicity 是一个无标签框架，通过评估交叉拟合留出基因上的模型差异，在非劣效性测试下针对随机种子变异进行校准，构建统计可接受的模型集或 Rashomon 集，无需谱系标签。多重性很大，更多取决于模型空间的多样性而非其大小：第二个算法的十二种配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，而第一个算法的二十四种配置暴露 3.8%。然后测试逐细胞认证命运边际 FM 是否比拟合模型已提供的产生更可靠的分配，结果并非如此。在模拟真实值上，在相同细胞上，FM 以 AUC 0.682 区分错误分配，而基线配置自身的决策边际为 0.965（p = 0.003），种子离散基线为 0.854。信息量由所接纳集的广度而非其基数决定：在基数四时，种子重拟合给出 0.933，超参数扰动集给出 0.701。将下确界放宽到

extra.description: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
items.title_zh: LongZero：从零数据增强LLM长上下文推理
items.summary_zh: 强化学习（RL）是增强大语言模型（LLM）长上下文推理的有效方法，但需要长、多样、有挑战且可验证的训练数据。此类数据的人工标注昂贵，自然出现的数据过于稀缺，无法支撑RL，而现有合成方法依赖外部语料或更强的教师模型，随着被训练模型变强，这些越来越难以获得。近期，从零数据RL——模型从自己提出的任务中学习——已取得优异性能，但现有方法针对短上下文任务。因此，我们提出$\textbf{LongZero}$，一种让LLM在无任何外部数据的情况下提升自身长上下文推理的方法。LongZero不是基于现有文档写问题和答案，而是先让模型以紧凑结构化形式合成问题、答案及其支持证据，然后单独将证据扩展为长多文档上下文。LongZero将这些自写多跳推理任务与自写多轮检索任务结合，并用GRPO训练模型。我们在两个LLM上跨五个长上下文推理基准评估LongZero，并与基于外部语料合成数据的RL比较。实验结果表明

extra.description: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable. Human annotation of such data is expensive, naturally occurring data are too scarce to sustain RL, and existing synthesis methods depend on external corpora or stronger teacher models, which become harder to obtain as the trained models get stronger. Recently, RL from zero data, in which a model learns from tasks it proposes itself, has achieved excellent performance, but existing methods target short-context tasks. Therefore, we propose $\textbf{LongZero}$, a method that lets an LLM improve its own long-context reasoning without any external data. Instead of writing questions and answers over existing documents, LongZero first has the model synthesize the question and answer with its supporting evidence in a compact structured form, and only then separately expands the evidence into a long multi-document context. LongZero combines these self-written multi-hop reasoning tasks with self-written multi-round retrieval tasks and trains the model with GRPO. We evaluate LongZero on two LLMs across five long-context reasoning benchmarks and compare it with RL on data synthesized from external corpora. Experimental results show that LongZero can generalize to real tasks, and outperforms both baselines, suggesting a viable and promising path to improving long-context reasoning of LLMs.

items.title: Think Harder Where It Matters: Item-Level Adaptive Recursion for Sequential Recommendation
items.title_zh: 在关键处更深入思考：面向序列推荐的物品级自适应递归
items.summary_zh: 现有序列推荐器通常为用户交互历史中的每个物品分配固定计算预算，而不论该物品对最终预测的贡献。我们通过两项诊断发现挑战这一事实上的设计。（1）非均匀计算需求：同一序列内的物品所需计算量差异巨大。大多数在浅层处理后收敛，而关键少数仅在全深度时稳定。（2）固定分配次优：在可获知目标物品的oracle条件下，非均匀深度分配始终优于固定分配，表明现有均匀计算既在已收敛物品上浪费容量，又牺牲整体推荐质量。这些观察促使从固定深度计算转向物品级自适应推理。为此，我们提出LoopRec。LoopRec递归应用单个权重共享块，并在每个递归边界引入轻量门控，对每个物品独立做出二元退出或继续决策。表示已充分成熟的物品提前退出，而需要更深推理的物品继续后续递归。该设计将固定全局深度转化为学习的逐物品属性，无需辅助深度标签，且易于适配多种骨干架构。在公开基准上对四个骨干系列的广泛实验表明，LoopRec始终优于匹配的

extra.description: Existing sequential recommenders usually allocate a fixed computational budget to every item in a user's interaction history, regardless of the item's contribution to the final prediction. We challenge this de facto design with two diagnostic findings. (1) Non-uniform computational need: items within the same sequence vary drastically in how much computation they require. Most converge after shallow processing while a critical minority only stabilizes at full depth. (2) Suboptimality of fixed allocation: given oracle access to the target item, a non-uniform depth assignment consistently outranks the fixed one, indicating that existing uniform computation both wastes capacity on already-converged items and sacrifices overall recommendation quality. These observations motivate a shift from fixed-depth computation to item-level adaptive reasoning. To this end, we propose LoopRec. LoopRec recursively applies a single weight-shared block and introduces a lightweight gate at each recursion boundary that makes a binary exit-or-continue decision for every item independently. Items whose representations have sufficiently matured exit early, while those requiring deeper reasoning continue to subsequent recursions. This design converts the fixed global depth into a learned, per-item property without auxiliary depth labels, and is readily adaptable to diverse backbone architectures. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks with four backbone families demonstrate that LoopRec consistently outperforms matched fixed-depth counterparts. Further analysis reveals that LoopRec's learned allocation exhibits interpretable patterns aligned with our post-hoc oracle analysis: lower-frequency items and more recent interactions naturally receive deeper computation. Our code is available at https://github.com/Elpmis117/LoopRec.

items.title: Environment Duels: A Microcosm of LLM Co-Evolution
items.title_zh: 环境对决：LLM共同进化的微观世界
items.summary_zh: 通过真实世界交互的复杂网络，从合成训练流程到开放网络共享的数据，前沿LLM吸收其前身和竞争者创造的内容。每个模型作为创造者和求解者在生态系统中扮演角色的表现如何？我们推出Environment Duels，一个动态智能体基准，在交互环境中评估这两种能力。每个模型编写环境，每个环境带有一个特权提示，目标是让有能力的求解者在无提示时失败、有提示时通过。在九个前沿LLM中，求解和编写被证明是不同技能：最强求解者并非最强编写者，而较小模型从他人玩法中学到更多，并编写出最难的环境和最有用的提示。除分数外，成对交互构成模型如何相互影响的微观世界。正面对决结果具有传递性，因而产生稳定排名；独立编写者收敛到相同设计；在一项使用Qwen3.8-27B的强化学习研究中，学习者在某编写者环境上的提示提升，与该环境训练在留出推理和智能体基准上对其提升程度相关，无论环境是自身还是另一模型的。这些模式各自都能在模型于

extra.description: Through a tangle of real-world interactions, from synthetic training pipelines to data shared on the open web, frontier LLMs absorb what their predecessors and competitors create. How well does each model play its role in this ecosystem, as a creator and as a solver? We introduce Environment Duels, a dynamic agentic benchmark that evaluates both capabilities on interactive environments. Each model writes environments, each with a privileged hint, aiming for tasks that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it. Across nine frontier LLMs, solving and authoring prove to be distinct skills: the strongest solvers are not the strongest authors, while smaller models learn more from how others played and write the hardest environments and the most useful hints. Beyond the scores, the pairwise interactions form a microcosm of how models affect one another. Head-to-head outcomes are transitive and so yield a stable ranking; independent authors converge on the same designs; and in a reinforcement-learning study with Qwen3.8-27B, the learner's hint lift on an author's environments tracks how much training on those environments improves it on held-out reasoning and agentic benchmarks, whether the environments are its own or another model's. Each of these patterns has a counterpart in how models shape one another outside the duel. By staging these interactions under controlled conditions, Environment Duels offers a window onto how LLMs teach, challenge and learn from one another. Code is available at https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels.

items.title: Scalable Enzyme Reaction Retrieval Enables Metagenomic Biocatalyst Discovery
items.title_zh: 可扩展的酶反应检索实现宏基因组生物催化剂发现
items.summary_zh: 酶催化反应驱动代谢，并在生物技术和可持续合成中实现多样化应用，但为未表征的酶分配催化功能以及为目标反应寻找酶仍然是重大挑战。尽管机器学习取得了近期进展，将酶功能预测转化为跨广阔未表征蛋白质和生化反应空间的系统性发现仍然具有挑战性。在此我们提出EzHit，一个用于双向酶反应检索的轻量级框架。在酶注释、孤儿反应检索和家族特异性微调基准中，EzHit取得了强劲的排名靠前性能，并优于代表性的酶反应匹配基线。我们进一步表明，基于马氏距离的几何置信度提供了比概率导出的不确定性度量或证据学习更有用的可靠性估计，使得能够对高分候选进行置信度感知的优先级排序。由于其高效性，EzHit被应用于近万亿规模的OMG_Prot50与RHEA筛选，在3027万条预测酶序列中产生了82亿条保留的酶反应关联。实验验证进一步确认了EzHit优先排序的宏基因组酶候选对稀疏注释反应的活性。总之，这些结果确立了EzHit作为酶注

extra.description: Enzyme catalyzed reactions drive metabolism and enable diverse applications in biotechnology and sustainable synthesis, but assigning catalytic functions to uncharacterized enzymes and finding enzymes for target reactions remain major challenges. Despite recent advances in machine learning, translating enzyme function prediction into systematic discovery across the vast space of uncharacterized proteins and biochemical reactions remains challenging. Here we present EzHit, a lightweight framework for bidirectional enzyme reaction retrieval. Across enzyme annotation, orphan-reaction retrieval and family-specific fine-tuning benchmarks, EzHit achieved strong top-ranked performance and outperformed representative enzyme reaction matching baselines. We further show that Mahalanobis distance based geometric confidence provides more useful reliability estimates than probability-derived uncertainty metrics or evidential learning, enabling confidence-aware prioritization of high scoring candidates. Owing to its efficiency, EzHit was applied to a nearly trillion-scale OMG_Prot50 with RHEA screen, yielding 8.20 billion retained enzyme reaction associations across 30.27 million predicted enzyme sequences. Experimental validation further confirmed the activity of EzHit prioritized metagenomic enzyme candidates for a sparsely annotated reaction. Together, these results establish EzHit as a scalable framework for enzyme annotation, reaction-guided mining and biocatalyst discovery

items.title: Determining cellular phylogeny and migration at high resolution in spatial genomics
items.title_zh: 在空间基因组学中以高分辨率确定细胞系统发育和迁移
items.summary_zh: 细胞迁移和肿瘤进化是组织稳态和癌症生物学的核心。空间基因组学的快速进展提出了利用体细胞突变在人体组织中原位追踪这些过程的可能性。然而，空间基因组学测量中频繁的数据丢失使这难以实现。在此我们提出StarTrak（用于体细胞变异调用和追踪的空间谱系重建分析），一个在单像素空间分辨率下进行体细胞变异调用和谱系重建的框架。StarTrak采用神经网络框架整合突变证据（来自核和线粒体读数）、空间邻近性、组织学图像和转录组状态，以识别空间信息丰富的突变模式。它在不同组织类型和空间组学平台（在空间ATAC-seq中尤为成功）上表现稳健。将StarTrak应用于肿瘤切片，我们推断突变肿瘤细胞向邻近非恶性组织的迁移，并重建与不同空间区域相关的不同谱系树。值得注意的是，我们识别出转录组状态几乎相同但突变谱不同的肿瘤区域。此外，对于皮肤切片，StarTrak在非恶性表皮中识别出日光相关突变，并有证据表明这些突变

extra.description: Cellular migration and tumor evolution are central to tissue homeostasis and cancer biology. Rapid advances in spatial genomics have raised the possibility of using somatic mutations to track these processes in situ in human tissues. However, frequent data dropouts in spatial genomics measurements make this challenging to implement. Here, we present StarTrak (SpaTial Analysis for lineage ReconsTRuction with somatic vAriant calling and tracKing), a framework for somatic variant calling and lineage reconstruction at single-pixel spatial resolution. StarTrak employs a neural network framework to integrate mutational evidence (from both nuclear and mitochondrial reads), spatial proximity, histological images, and transcriptomic states to identify spatially informative patterns of mutations. It performs robustly across tissue types and spatial-omics platforms (being particularly successful with spatial ATAC-seq). Applying StarTrak to tumor sections, we infer the migration of mutated tumor cells into adjacent non-malignant tissues and reconstruct distinct lineage trees associated with different spatial regions. Notably, we identify tumor regions with nearly identical transcriptomic states but distinct mutational profiles. Moreover, for skin sections, StarTrak identifies sunlight-associated mutations in non-malignant epidermis and evidence suggesting the migration of these mutant surface cells into deeper skin layers. Overall, by integrating mutation calling with spatial context, StarTrak enables the inference of spatially resolved cellular migration and cellular phylogeny.

items.title: Targeting skin ageing at the source: a novel cellular reprogramming approach using natural extract combinations
items.title_zh: 从源头靶向皮肤衰老：一种使用天然提取物组合的新型细胞重编程方法
items.summary_zh: 细胞衰老是皮肤衰老的驱动因素，导致结构退化和美学变化。本研究评估了一种新型衰老形态策略，使用天然小分子的协同组合通过上游ERK/AKT信号通路靶向RNA剪接调控。评估了天然等同合成分子及相应提取物对自然衰老的人原代皮肤细胞的细胞毒性、对衰老细胞负荷的影响、增殖、DNA损伤负荷和SASP标志物。使用暴露于1.5 J/cm² UVC照射的3D人体离体全层皮肤外植体评估了一种局部简单配方对衰老和皮肤结构的影响。H. lupulus和G. biloba提取物的组合在衰老真皮成纤维细胞中产生高达45%的剂量依赖性衰老形态效应，在衰老的人原代角质形成细胞中产生10%的效应（p ≤ 0.0001和0.001），且不诱导细胞增殖。还观察到DNA损伤负荷减少50%（p ≤ 0.0001）。定性上，该简单配方减轻了UV诱导的表皮增生，恢复了胶原纤维组织，并减少了衰老和炎症标志物。靶向细胞衰老是解决皮肤衰老根本

extra.description: Cellular senescence is a driver of skin ageing that leads to structural deterioration and aesthetic changes. This study evaluated a novel senomorphic strategy, using synergistic combinations of natural small molecules to target RNA splicing regulation via upstream ERK/AKT signaling pathways. Nature-identical synthetic molecules, and corresponding extracts were assessed for cytotoxicity, impact on senescent cell load, proliferation, DNA damage load and SASP markers in naturally aged human primary skin cells. A topical, simple formulation was evaluated for impact on senescence and skin structure using 3D human ex vivo full-thickness skin explants exposed to 1.5 J/cm2 UVC irradiation. Combination of H. lupulus and G. biloba extracts produced a dose-dependent senomorphic impact of up to 45% in aged dermal fibroblasts and 10% in aged human primary keratinocytes (p [≤] 0.0001 & 0.001), without inducing cell proliferation. A 50% decrease in DNA damage load was also observed (p [≤] 0.0001). Qualitatively, the simple formulation mitigated UV-induced epidermal hyperplasia, restored collagen fiber organization, and reduced markers of senescence and inflammation. Targeting cellular senescence is an emerging traction point to address the root biological causes of skin ageing. Targeting the splicing dysregulation/senescence axis using combinations of natural plant extracts may provide a novel mode of action to reprogram senescent cells for repair and protection of skin structure and function.

items.title: 女子离婚后发现前夫婚内继承 400 多万房款，起诉要求分割这笔钱财，法院判决支持，如何从法律角度解读？
items.title_zh: 女子离婚后发现前夫婚内继承 400 多万房款，起诉要求分割这笔钱财，法院判决支持，如何从法律角度解读？
items.summary_zh: 在一场离婚纠纷中，女方发现婚姻存续期间男方继承母亲房产份额。婚内继承的遗产，离婚时是否要分割？北京市第三中级人民法院的法官对此进行解读。 李女士与张先生在离婚时签署协议，约定分割婚后夫妻共同购买的房产以及存款，男方自愿补偿女方100万元。离婚后，因张先生未按约支付100万元补偿款，李女士诉至法院。 庭审中，李女士意外得知，张先生母亲在自己与张先生婚姻存续期间去世，还留有一套房产，张先生与其他兄弟姐妹办理继承公证，并按遗嘱继承62.5%的份额。 后四人共同将该房出售，张先生分得售房款400余万元。李女士认为，继承发生在婚姻存续期间，该笔售房款应属夫妻共同财产，于是再次起诉，要求分割张先生所得售房款。 该案核心争议在于，婚姻关系存续期间一方继承所得的财产，离婚后另一方是否有权要求分割？https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/lL-XetZ8VgYqUy_BsHtf_A

items.title: 曝某明星长期借不到高定，自费购买礼服后引该品牌PR暴怒，可能会是谁？为啥自费购买也会引起高奢品牌不满？
items.title_zh: 曝某明星长期借不到高定，自费购买礼服后引该品牌PR暴怒，可能会是谁？为啥自费购买也会引起高奢品牌不满？
items.summary_zh: 曝艺人自费高定。起因是长期借不到高定引发粉丝不满，圈内猜测指向个别90花 | 高定借不到，可以自己买。几十万一条，买完先跟品牌借件样衣穿，成衣得等半年才到你手上。 今天凌晨一个时尚博主爆的料：有艺人一口气买了两条顶级高定，起因是工作室长期借不到，粉丝在评论区闹了很久。全程没点名，一上午网友忙着猜，被点到名的几家粉丝晒别家物料自证。 借高定这道门，看的是品牌对你商业价值、作品、形象适配的判断，跟你有多少钱没关系。借衣要提前发函，品牌裁缝飞过来量体改衣，穿完专人核验，蹭破一点要赔。全球拿到法国高级时装工会认证的高定品牌，不到50家。 所以“穿上高定”和“借到高定”是两件事：前者靠钱，后者靠牌面。自费买，圈内话叫补票。 买完当场还穿不了。高定按你身材现做，工期半年起，先跟品牌借一件样衣上台，成衣好了再还回去。钱大概率也不是她自己想花。粉丝天天在评论区问“姐姐的高定呢”，工作室的压力就压在这条裙子

items.title: 泽连斯基表示，乌克兰愿在保留至少75%领土控制权的基础上达成和平协议，你怎么看？
items.title_zh: 泽连斯基表示，乌克兰愿在保留至少75%领土控制权的基础上达成和平协议，你怎么看？
items.summary_zh: 据央视新闻消息，当地时间10月21日，乌克兰总统泽连斯基在接受采访时表示，乌方可在保留至少75%领土控制权的基础上达成和平协议。 主持人向泽连斯基提问称，他是否愿意接受一项和平协议，把一切按现状冻结下来，乌方仍然保有75%或更多的国土。泽连斯基予以肯定回答，称“现在我们必须冻结（战线），这是结束这场战争的切实办法。”（总台记者 董薇）泽连斯基：愿在保留至少75%领土控制权的基础上达成和平协议 - 新京报泽连斯基：愿在保留75%领土控制权的基础上达成和平协议

items.title: 网友称黄豆吃多在列车连放128个闷屁，疑多位同车厢乘客称被臭到怀疑人生，黄豆吃多「危害」真有这么大吗？
items.title_zh: 网友称黄豆吃多在列车连放128个闷屁，疑多位同车厢乘客称被臭到怀疑人生，黄豆吃多「危害」真有这么大吗？
items.summary_zh: 暑假返校前一天，我奶奶炒了一大盘盐焗黄豆，香气扑鼻，我馋得直流口水。我抱着盘子蹲在院子里，一口气吃了满满三大碗，还灌了两瓶冰可乐。奶奶在旁边一直念叨，说黄豆吃多了容易胀气，让我少吃点，我根本没当回事，觉得自己年轻火力旺，这点小事算什么。结果第二天刚下火车没半小时，我的肚子就开始咕噜咕噜响，像揣了个不停运转的小马达。一开始我还能勉强忍着，可实在憋不住的时候，只好趁着火车过隧道哐当哐当响的间隙，悄悄缓解一下。那味道实在难以形容，带着一股发酵的黄豆酱味，瞬间就在周围散开了。坐在我旁边的大叔最先察觉到，猛地吸了一下鼻子，眉头瞬间皱成了疙瘩，赶紧用袖子捂住了口鼻。紧接着对面的阿姨也开始咳嗽，翻出三层口罩戴上，还一个劲往窗户边挪。我心里紧张，怕被别人发现是我弄出的动静，但还是假装没事人一样低头玩手机。本来以为这事应该就这样过去了，谁知道没过多久又没忍住。我还是重复着刚才的操作，趁着隧道声响时悄悄缓解，

items.title_zh: 湖北一高校发布通知，严禁老师上课全程依赖PPT，能有效提高教学质量吗？可以推广吗？
items.summary_zh: 湖北一高校发布通知，严禁老师上课全程依赖PPT，能有效提高教学质量吗？可以推广吗？ https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/J4CraR8ORsZJ11U946CUCw 10月13日，湖北汽车工业学院教务处发布《关于进一步提升课堂教学质量的通知》，其中提出“坚持核心板书，助力知识内化”，要求教师对课程中的重要术语、关键公式及专业缩写进行规范板书。严禁全程依赖PPT，确保学生有充足时间记录、理解并掌握核心知识点。 各教学单位： 为切实提升我校课堂教学质量，针对近期教学督导在巡课中发现的共性问题，现就进一步规范课堂教学、优化教学效果提出如下建议与要求，请各单位传达至全体教师并督促落实： 一、强化实物教学，增强感性认知 针对工科类课程，鼓励教师选取典型零部件或材料样品带入课堂，供学生传阅观察。通过实物展示弥补纯理论教学的不足，帮助学生建立直观认知，提升理论与实践结合的教学效果。 二

items.summary_zh: 10月21日，红果短剧官方账号发布《关于红果短剧计划下线金币功能的公告》 红果短剧计划分阶段下线金币功能：预计自2026年11月1日起，不再向新用户提供金币功能；2026年12月底前，全面下线金币功能。具体计划如下： 一、自2026年11月1日起，当天及之后新激活的用户，将不再获得金币功能及相关入口。此前已在使用金币功能的用户，在这一阶段不受影响，可继续正常使用。 二、2026年12月31日前，红果短剧将面向所有用户下线金币功能，停止发放金币，具体安排请关注后续公告。 三、您已获得的金币和现金余额权益不受影响。在金币功能调整前，我们将通过相关页面通知等方式持续提醒，并留出充足的金币兑换和现金提现时间。具体截止时间及相关安排另行通知，请留意后续公告和App内提醒。如有疑问，可联系红果短剧App客服。 红果短剧宣布下线金币功能：自11月1日起，不再向新用户提供金币功能_相关_公告_现金余额ht

items.title: 张雪公开求助如何让食堂的米饭好吃，不少人送米上门，张雪称不是米的问题，食堂做米饭有哪些技术难点？
items.title_zh: 张雪公开求助如何让食堂的米饭好吃，不少人送米上门，张雪称不是米的问题，食堂做米饭有哪些技术难点？
items.summary_zh: 10月19日，张雪机车创始人张雪在社交平台发布视频，向全网公开求助：谁能把其公司食堂的米饭做得好吃，可获奖励，甚至还可以承包公司食堂。 张雪在视频中表示，感觉公司食堂蒸出来的米饭没有家里电饭煲蒸出来的好吃，“如果你有能力能让1000多人的饭变得好吃，我可以买你的设备，你也可以来给我咨询，我可以给你付费。” 10月20日，张雪发布最新视频作出回应：“不要再给我们送米了，不是米的问题”“换个米就能把米饭做好吃，这个都不会，那我们公司包括我在内就是一群蠢猪”。他表示，视频发出后不少人专程送米上门，但食堂并不需要大米。在他看来，倘若仅靠换米就能改善米饭口感，团队完全可以自行解决。

items.title: 日本关键稀土钇储备将耗尽，求助美国敦促中方放宽管制，稀土将耗尽一事将对日方产生多大影响？
items.title_zh: 日本关键稀土钇储备将耗尽，求助美国敦促中方放宽管制，稀土将耗尽一事将对日方产生多大影响？
items.summary_zh: 据英国《金融时报》10月20日报道，有知情人士透露，日本关键金属钇的供应仅能维持数月，已经请求美国协助劝说中方放宽稀土出口管制，以避免制造业停产。 一位日本政府官员称：“（我们）所谈论的时间表不是以年计，而是以月计，眼下要考虑的是如何熬过明年。”(环球时报记者 郑璇) 10月21日，外交部发言人毛宁主持例行记者会。 法新社记者提问，据报道，日本关键稀土元素钇的储备即将耗尽，仅能维持数月。日方已请求美国协助，敦促中国放宽相关的出口管制。请问外交部对此有何评论？ 毛宁指出，中方依法依规对日本实施出口管制，目的是制止日本“再军事化”和拥核企图。中方维护关键矿产全球产供链稳定与安全的立场没有变化，各方都有责任为此发挥建设性作用。日本请求美国协助敦促中方放宽稀土管制，中方回应 | 极目新闻英媒：日本关键稀土仅够维持数月，日本已请求美国劝说中方放宽稀土出口管制

items.title_zh: 理想汽车发布电池保障政策，称将对电池不自燃提供终身保障，你认为这一举措能够赢得市场信任吗？
items.summary_zh: 据介绍，连山电池具备长寿命特性，采用高稳定正极、低锂耗负极设计，搭配电解液双配方长寿命技术，支持持续动态修复。理想汽车官方表示，电芯材料级改善 + 电池包高度集成 + 整车级调度 = 全系车型续航提升，同时连山电池全系 8 年或 16 万公里电池健康度≥75%。 另外，理想汽车的连山电驱采用自主专利 CAR119 铸铝转子材料，城市纯电续航提升超 15km、高速纯电续航提升超 8km；理想还将传统功率模块进行了系统性重构，让电流可以直通芯片，续航提升 30km，同时头部空间释放 24mm。理想汽车认为，下一代电驱系统体积不变大，动力续航一起涨。 理想汽车“连山”完整自研三电技术体系发布，覆盖电池、电驱、充电网络_km_续航_保障理想汽车“连山”完整自研三电技术体系发布，覆盖电池、电驱、充电网络

items.title: 央行将退出存贷款基准利率，用市场化利率指标来替代，如何解读这一变化带来的影响？
items.title_zh: 央行将退出存贷款基准利率，用市场化利率指标来替代，如何解读这一变化带来的影响？
items.summary_zh: 在2026金融街论坛年会开幕式上，中国人民银行行长潘功胜表示，退出存贷款基准利率。随着利率市场化改革推进，存贷款基准利率逐步被市场化的定价基准替代。 银行贷款利率已经有贷款市场报价利率、银行间隔夜回购利率等多个定价基准；自今年一季度开始，人民银行对外公布了各个期限的存款平均利率，作为银行存款定价的参考。下一步，人民银行将推动这些领域的计息依据用市场化的利率指标来替代，实现退出金融机构存贷款基准利率。（财联社）潘功胜：将退出存贷款基准利率 用市场化利率指标来替代
